security_model.description: HyperQL's security model uses DEFINE ACCESS ROLE and CREATE USER. Fine-grained filtering is provided by DEFINE ACCESS POLICY.

definitions.syntax: DEFINE ACCESS ROLE RoleName [ GRANT NAMESPACE NamespaceName PERMISSIONS [Permission, ...], GRANT NODE TypeName PERMISSIONS [Permission, ...], GRANT EDGE TypeName PERMISSIONS [Permission, ...], GRANT FIELD FieldName PERMISSIONS [Permission, ...], DENY NODE TypeName PERMISSIONS [Permission, ...] ];
definitions.description: Grants or denies permissions over namespaces, types, and fields. DENY takes precedence over GRANT.

definitions.syntax: CREATE USER username WITH PASSWORD "credential_or_provider_ref" [ROLES [Role1, Role2]];
ALTER USER username [ SET PASSWORD "new_credential", ADD ROLES [RoleName, ...], REMOVE ROLES [RoleName, ...] ];
GRANT ACCESS ROLE RoleName TO username;
REVOKE ACCESS ROLE RoleName FROM username;
DEFINE ACCESS POLICY PolicyName ON NodeType | EdgeType FOR ACCESS ROLE RoleName USING (condition_expression);
definitions.description: Fine-grained node/edge-level filtering. Transparent to queries. Condition has access to $current_user variable.
definitions.example: DEFINE ACCESS POLICY OwnOrdersOnly ON Order FOR ACCESS ROLE CustomerRole USING (owner_id == $current_user.id);

aggregation_functions.description: Aggregation functions operate on collections in RETURN clauses with GROUP BY, @computed properties, and role collections. v0.19: AggFn is a formally separate enum. AggFn calls are a distinct AST variant (AggCallExpr) [Decision 5].
aggregation_functions.structural_rules: AggCallExpr is structurally forbidden in positions that accept only scalar expressions. Valid in: RETURN, WITH (projection), and HAVING.

functions.name: COUNT
functions.desc: COUNT(*) counts all rows; COUNT(expr) counts non-nulls.

role_collection_aggregation.description: Aggregation over (MANY) role collections is built-in and does NOT require graph traversal.

sql_style.syntax: RETURN agg_func(expr), group_expr GROUP BY group_expr

with_style.syntax: WITH group_expr AS alias, COLLECT(var) AS collection RETURN ...

user_defined_aggregates.description: Custom aggregations defined via DEFINE AGGREGATE FUNCTION can be used interchangeably with built-in aggregation functions. Must be marked @pure. Graph access is forbidden.
user_defined_aggregates.syntax: RETURN Name(expr1, expr2) GROUP BY group_expr
user_defined_aggregates.example: RETURN p.Department, WeightedAvg(p.Salary, p.PerformanceScore) GROUP BY p.Department;

window_functions.description: Window functions perform calculations across a set of rows related to the current row. v0.19: WindowFn is a formally separate enum. WindowCallExpr carries a WindowSpec [Decision 5].
window_functions.structural_rules: Forbidden outside of RETURN and WITH (projection) contexts.

frame_specification.description: Defines the frame for aggregate and navigation window functions. Valid only when ORDER BY is present.

frame_types.ROWS: Defined in terms of physical row offsets.
frame_types.RANGE: Defined in terms of logical distance. Requires numeric/date ORDER BY.

defaults.with_order_by: RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
defaults.without_order_by: ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING

examples: SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cat ORDER BY date RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
